name: zcbc-website
description: Zion Chin Baptist Church website — React frontend and Strapi CMS

scripts.postinstall: node -e "if (!process.env.ZCBC_SETUP) console.log('\n  Next:  npm run setup   (creates .env files, installs frontend + CMS)\n')"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,cms -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend/church-cms run develop"
scripts.ci: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build
